description: Hijri date converter and Ethiopian calendar converter: convert a date between Gregorian and Hijri (Saudi Umm al-Qura and tabular), Ethiopian, Coptic, Persian Solar Hijri, Indian national (Saka) and Thai Buddhist calendars, both ways. Returns year, month, day, month name, era, weekday and the date in Arabic, Amharic, Persian, Hindi or Thai. Covers Saudi Arabia, Ethiopia, Egypt, Iran, India and Thailand. Source: Unicode CLDR/ICU. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD in the 'from' calendar, e.g. 2026-11-27, or 1448-09-01 with from=hijri

from.description: Calendar of 'date': gregorian (default), hijri (Umm al-Qura), islamic-civil, ethiopic, coptic, persian, indian (Saka) or buddhist (Thai)

to.description: Optional calendars to return, comma-separated (default: all 7)
